projects.name: Driftwake
projects.description: A 2D physics-driven sailing roguelike built solo in a custom engine. Every voyage rewrites the wind, the currents and the wreckage you can salvage from.
projects.subhead: A sailing roguelike where the sea is the opponent
projects.long: Driftwake pairs a hand-rolled 2D fluid simulation with roguelike run structure: every voyage rewrites the wind, the currents and the wreckage you can salvage from. Built the engine, tools and ship-building UI from scratch.
